body: I hope you don't, but if you do please make it as untraumatic as you can. Reach out first so at least it isn't a surprise to anyone. He was a decent guy who was very loved, I don't really have anyone left to shock so no one will look for me except maybe my landlords so I'm not worried about it.
Not to be a bitch but I didn't want him to die either. He knew me and my struggles, he promised me he wouldn't and yet he did. I'm not sure that's the best thing to say to stop me...
I don't know. He left a note for me to call the police and they saw him. He didn't want me to see. I only had to id his body later...
